Most roof problems start small — a cracked tile, a rusted valley, failed pointing. We find the actual source, show you photos of what we find, and repair it so the same leak doesn't come back next storm.

Roof Leak Repairs

A stain on the ceiling rarely sits under the real entry point. We trace the leak to its source before quoting.

Tile & Ridge Cap Repairs

Broken tiles and cracked ridge-cap bedding are the most common cause of leaks in Newcastle's tiled homes.

Metal & Colorbond Repairs

Rust spots, lifted sheets and perished screws let water in quietly. We repair metal roofs before small rust becomes a re-roof.

Warning Signs

Caught early, it's a repair.
Left alone, it's a ceiling.

If any of these sound familiar, the roof is already letting water in — or about to. A free inspection tells you exactly where you stand.

Drips or ceiling stains

Water marks, bubbling paint or a drip during rain means the leak is already inside.

Cracked or slipped tiles

Even one broken tile is an open door for water every time it rains.

Cracked ridge-cap pointing

When the mortar along the ridge cracks and lifts, rain runs straight underneath.

Overflowing gutters

Water spilling over in rain usually means blockages, sagging, or rusted-through sections.

Rust on a metal roof

Surface rust spreads fast in Newcastle's coastal air — treat it before sheets need replacing.

Mould or a musty roof space

A damp smell in the house often means slow, hidden leaks wetting the roof timbers.

Good Questions

Before you book a repair

How much does a roof repair cost?

It depends on what's actually wrong — a few broken tiles is a small job, while failed valleys or widespread ridge-cap cracking costs more. That's why the inspection is free: we look first, then give you one written fixed price. No work starts until you approve it.

Can you find a leak that others couldn't?

Leaks often travel — water enters at one point and shows up metres away on the ceiling. We inspect the roof surface, flashings, valleys and penetrations above the stain and work back to the entry point, rather than just patching where the drip appears.

Do I need a repair or a whole new roof?

Most roofs with localised damage — cracked tiles, failed pointing, a rusted valley — repair well and have years of life left. If the roof is genuinely at the end of its life, we'll show you the photos and explain why, so the decision is yours with evidence in hand.

What happens after a storm damages my roof?

Call us on (02) 9936 1040. We'll talk you through making things safe, inspect the damage, and document it with photos — which also helps if you're making an insurance claim. Then we quote the permanent repair in writing.

How soon can you come out?

We're based at 5 Bolton Street in the Newcastle CBD, so most Newcastle suburbs are a short drive. Call and we'll give you the earliest inspection time available — emergencies with active water entry are prioritised.
